answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by making each extra identity cost unshareable wall-clock work. To enroll, a candidate locks a bond and must finish a sequential delay puzzle bound to that bond and to one hardware key; the puzzle uses this epoch's public nonce, so farms cannot precompute it. Clones cannot split the delay across many keys without paying the delay again. The old fable that sign-ups are free dies here: you season one cedar post at a time before it can stand in the meadow, and a duplicate key or a reused nonce burns the bond.
